context.transcript:
Hello, this is Tonya Peterson.
Your landscaping company took care of my garden last year.
Your crew did such a beautiful job.
Are you available to help out again this year?
I was hoping to maintain the garden myself, but I'm scheduled to go on several business trips and won't have time for gardening after all.
Could you please email me a cost estimate as soon as possible?
I remember what you charged for your services last year, but I'd like to know what your current rates are.
Thanks.
context.transcript_translation:
您好，我是 Tonya Peterson。
去年是贵园林公司负责照料我的花园的。
你们的团队做得非常出色。
今年你们还有空再来帮忙吗？
我本来希望自己打理花园，但已经安排了好几次出差，结果还是抽不出时间做园艺工作。
能否请您尽快通过电子邮件给我发一份费用估算？
我记得你们去年的服务收费，但想了解一下目前的价格。
谢谢。
